summary: Pampanga 3rd District representative with 155 principal-authored bills. Authored 4Ps expansion, a lifeline electricity rate for minimum-wage earners, tertiary education subsidy expansion, a presidential merit scholarship, travel-tax abolition, an anti-dynasty ban and deepfake penalties. Also authored many electric and media franchise grants.
caveat: Anti-dynasty and deepfake items are single issues and unscored. Franchise grants and renaming bills carry no ideological signal.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored 4Ps expansion (-3), tertiary education subsidy (-2) and a lifeline electricity rate for minimum-wage earners (-2), against travel tax abolition (+1). Merit scholarship neutral.
